jobs.title: Assistant Professor – Artificial Intelligence Education
jobs.description: Assistant Professor – Artificial Intelligence Education 503968 Las Cruces, New Mexico, United States Faculty 9-Month Faculty Full-Time Closing at: Oct 16 2026 - 23:55 MDT View favorites Department Contact: Enrico Pontelli, 575-646-2001, epontell@nmsu.edu Internal or External Search: External - Open to all applicants Advertising Summary: New Mexico State University invites applications for two tenure-track Assistant Professor positions in Applied AI (9-month appointments). Faculty will join an interdisciplinary cluster hire and be affiliated with the new Institute for Applied Practice in AI and Machine Learning. Position Details Position Title: Assistant Professor – Artificial Intelligence Education College/Division: Arts and Sciences College Department: 330500-COMPUTER SCIENCE Location: Las Cruces Offsite Location (if applicable): Target Hourly/Salary Rate: Commensurate with qualification Appointment Full-time Equivalency: 1.0 FLSA Status: Exempt Bargaining Unit Announcement: This is NOT a bargaining unit position with American Federation of State, County & Municipal Employees (AFSCME). Contingent Upon Funding: Not Applicable Standard Work Schedule: Standard (M-F, 8-5) If Not a Standard Work Schedule: Job Duties and Responsibilities: Faculty in this position are expected to:• Conduct innovative, externally funded research on the teaching, learning and application of artificial intelligence, including AI pedagogy, curriculum design, credentialing, and the study of the most effective ways to teach AI to different audiences (students, professionals, educators, and community members).• Teach undergraduate and graduate courses in artificial intelligence and its applications, contributing to AI curriculum development across disciplines• Partner with domain specialists across colleges to design and build curricula that embed AI into disciplinary programs of study.• Lead the development of microcredentials, certificates, and other flexible credentialing pathways in AI.• Develop and deliver AI training and workforce development programs for diverse audiences within and beyond the university.• Advise and mentor students at the undergraduate, master’s, and doctoral levels.• Engage in professional and institutional service, including outreach, committee participation, and strategic initiatives.• Dedicate a portion of assigned effort to the educational activities of the NMSU Institute for Applied Practice in AI and Machine Learning, and promote NMSU’s role as a leader in AI education for the state and region. Qualifications Required Education and Experience: Education: Earned Ph.D. in a discipline relevant to the position (e.g., artificial intelligence, computing or computational sciences, learning sciences, education, or a relevant AI applied field, e.g., agriculture or manufacturing) by the time of hire.Experience:• Demonstrated expertise as an AI generalist with a primary focus on teaching, AI curriculum development, credentialing, pedagogy, or educational integration of artificial intelligence.• Evidence of scholarly productivity or high potential for conducting research in educational frameworks, curriculum design, or pedagogical methods related to AI.• Experience or strong potential for securing external funding to support computing/AI education and program development.• Demonstrated commitment to excellence in teaching, curriculum development, and student mentoring.Additional Qualifications:• Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, multidisciplinary academic environment.• Preferred experience includes development of microcredentials or professional training programs, integration of AI into non-computing curricula, responsible AI practices, and support of diverse student populations. Equivalent Qualifications: Preferred Qualifications: Please submit the following documentation with the application:-CV-Statement of Teaching-Statement of Research Special Certification/Licensure: Working Conditions and Physical Effort Environment: Work is normally performed in a typical interior/office work environment. Physical Effort: No or very limited physical effort required. Lifting Requirements: Requires handling of average-weight objects up to 10 pounds or some standing or walking. Risk: No or very limited exposure to physical risk.

jobs.description: Sign InCreate ProfileEnglish (US)Assistant Professor of DermatologyAlbuquerque, NM, United States|req37471Posted on: 8/14/2026 Back to SearchAssistant Professor of Dermatology Posting Numberreq37471 Employment TypeFaculty Faculty Type Hiring DepartmentDermatology Administration (627B) Academic Location Benefits EligibleThe University of New Mexico provides a comprehensive package of benefits including medical, dental, vision, and life insurance. In addition, UNM offers educational benefits through the tuition remission and dependent education programs. See the Benefits home page for more information. Position SummaryThe University of New Mexico (UNM) School of Medicine Department of Dermatology in Albuquerque seeks qualified enthusiastic individuals for full-time academic faculty positions in General Dermatology at Assistant Professor in either Clinical Educator or Flex Track. We serve a large, truly diverse, and medically complex patient population. As the only academic health center/flagship institution for the entire state, we are the consultative resource for Dermatology in New Mexico (population 2.1 million) and also serve the Four Corners region of the Southwest. Our population is uniquely multicultural and multilingual, with 22 American Indian tribes and nations (11-12% census population as of 2021) as well as vibrant Hispanic/Latinx (50%), African American (3%), and Asian American (2%) communities. Due to low numbers of practicing specialists in rural areas, our faculty and trainees see the entire spectrum of clinical dermatology, including but not limited to: general and pediatric dermatology, Mohs surgery/cutaneous oncology, dermatopathology, aesthetics, and complex inpatient/medical dermatology. Our main UNM Hospital clinical site offers phototherapy and lasers, we have multiple clinical locations (primarily in Albuquerque but also in Rio Rancho and Gallup), and the Department/training program has an exceptional partnership with the local VA Medical Center as well. At the UNM Department of Dermatology, we pride ourselves in our excellence and commitment to all mission areas, training residents to practice at their highest level and offering robust clinical exposure, high-quality education/professional development, research opportunities and a longstanding dedication to community engagement and diversity/equity/inclusivity and belonging. The ACGME-accredited residency program is currently allotted 4 residents/year, supervised by approximately 10 faculty, including UNM-based, VAMC, Dermatopathology/Pathology and community physicians with Letters of Academic Title. QualificationsMinimum Requirements: Medical Doctor or equivalent Board-eligible or certified in Dermatology Eligible for medical licensure in NM Eligible for State of New Mexico Board of Pharmacy certification and federal DEA registration Must be eligible to work in the U.S. Preferred Qualifications:· Interest/expertise in complex medical dermatology/consultative inpatient service· Interest/expertise in clinical research/translational science· Interest/expertise in undergraduate medical education (UME) and/or formal student mentoring· Demonstrable experience promoting inclusion in the workforce and working with learners of diverse backgrounds· Knowledge and modelling of cultural humility· A demonstrated commitment to cultivate and understanding of the rich and varied cultures of New Mexico and to the success of the university’s mission to serve local and global communities Application Instructions Only applications submitted through the official UNMJobs site will be accepted. If you are viewing this job advertisement on a 3rd party site, please visit UNMJobs to submit an application. Candidate should address each of these in cover letter/application: Interest/expertise in complex medical dermatology/consultative inpatient service. Interest/expertise in clinical research/translational science. Interest/expertise in undergraduate medical education (UME) and/or formal student mentoring. Demonstrable experience promoting inclusion in the workforce and working with learners of diverse backgrounds. Knowledge and modelling of cultural humility. Commitment to cultivate an understanding of the rich and varied cultures of New Mexico and to the success of the university's mission to serve local and global communities. For Assistance with the Application Process, contact Azucena Villa, Search Coordinator, (505) 272-7089, avilla@salud.unm.edu For Best ConsiderationFor best consideration, please apply by 8/29/2026. This position will remain open until filled. The University of New Mexico is committed to hiring and retaining a diverse workforce. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, making decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, or any other protected class. jobs.description: Sign InCreate ProfileEnglish (US)Elementary After-School InstructorAlbuquerque, NM, United States|req37390Posted on: 8/4/2026 Back to SearchStudent Intermediate Level Requisition IDreq37390 Working TitleElementary After-School Instructor Pay$16.00 Hourly CampusMain - Albuquerque, NM DepartmentOff Campus Work Study (454F) Employment TypeStudent Employment Student TypeWork-Study StatusNon-Exempt Background Check RequiredYes For Best Consideration Date Position SummaryOrganization: Community For LearningLocation: Elementary Schools located throughout AlbuquerqueAn Off-Campus Work-Study Position -MUST have a Work-Study AwardThis program requires a work schedule of 15-18 hours per week, and availability for afternoon program 2-6pm. Times vary depending on site hours of operation; this will be discussed during interview process. This is an off-campus work-study position with Community For Learning located throughout the Albuquerque Metro Area. Community For Learning (CFL) Project SEAL provides social, emotional & academic based after- school and summer programs in ten Albuquerque school communities. Primarily with Kinder-5th grade. Instructors will have the opportunity to work in an after-school/before-school program designed to help at-risk students to build resiliency, improve academic skills, and promote social skills. Instructors will work together with CFL staff to create a safe, educated, effective, and empowered school community that will improve the lives of all that participate. Staff members will use positive techniques to guide the behavior of children and youth and are encouraged to interact with each other in positive ways. Activities and curriculum are hands-on, researched based, and reflect the wants and needs of children, families, community and the school. Programming includes opportunities to develop academic skills, engage in recreation and outdoor play, participate in meaningful service-learning projects, enhance creativity and express themselves through art, explore and develop interests and talents, learn to work as part of a team, develop positive character traits, and develop leadership skills. Minimum QualificationsEquivalencies not found for this position Preferred Qualifications Applicants must be hardworking, caring, responsible, and eager to work with children and their families. Experience working with children and community is helpful. Fluent Spanish or ASL speakers are strongly encouraged to apply. Instructors must be willing to act as an effective member of a team. Strong interpersonal and problem-solving skills, flexibility and an ability to conduct professional and considerate interactions are a must. Application Instructions Only applications submitted through the official UNMJobs site will be accepted. If you are viewing this job advertisement on a 3rd party site, please visit UNMJobs to submit an application. Please Submit a Resume and Cover Letter. Background Check required. jobs.description: Instructor, Nursing Print Instructor, Nursing Salary $65,000.00 - $72,500.00 Annually Location ENMU - Roswell, NM Job Type Full time permanent Job Number 2026-00012 Department ENMU-Roswell Opening Date 02/24/2026 Description Benefits Questions Position Overview Degree Level: Total Annual PayAssociate Degree $65,000.00Bachelor Degree $67,500.00Master Degree $70,000.00Doctorate Degree $72,500.00All degree levels may qualify for a $9,000.00 annual stipend.Position Summary:The Nursing Instructor position is a full-time faculty appointment (9 to 10-month contract). Responsibilities include developing nursing curriculum and delivering instructional content in the classroom. The role also involves serving as nursing faculty in clinical settings, providing both direct and indirect supervision to students as they apply nursing clinical skills and make decisions. This position reports to the Director of Nursing.Duties and Responsibilities:Provide instruction for assigned Nursing courses and assist in coordinating adjunct faculty teaching in Nursing, if applicable. The standard teaching workload for regular full-time faculty consists of 15 semester workload hours, or the equivalent, per semester. Develop course syllabi in accordance with ENMU-Roswell’s standardized syllabus format. Supervise and direct students in clinical environments, which may include on-campus clinical rotations, simulations, or off-campus direct client care clinical rotations. Maintain a minimum of ten posted office hours per week. Keep accurate attendance records and follow institutional procedures for reporting student grades. Grades must reflect students’ demonstrated achievement and performance according to the course syllabus. Create a learning environment that fosters student engagement and motivation.Develop and administer assignments, quizzes, and examinations that align with course objectives and comprehensively assess student learning.Provide academic advising to nursing students. Participate in curriculum development and revision to ensure alignment with professional standards and educational best practices.Attend graduation ceremonies.Perform other duties as assigned. Requirements Minimum Job Requirements:Current, unencumbered license as a Registered Nurse in New Mexico in good standing or a current unencumbered compact state RN license (must obtain New Mexico RN license within 90 days of employment).Bachelor’s Degree in Nursing (must enroll in an accredited Master’s in Nursing program by the end of the first academic year of employment).Minimum of two years of nursing experience as a Registered Nurse in an acute care or long-term care setting.Preferred:Master’s Degree in Nursing from an accredited program.Administrative and/or supervisory experience.Experience in Nursing education.Experience with educational learning management systems (LMS).
